issues.description: The patch replaces glibc-only pthread_yield/pthread_*_affinity_np with POSIX sched_* calls. Verified to contain no platform macro (__OHOS__ etc.); sched_getaffinity(0, ...) has the same calling-thread semantics as pthread_getaffinity_np(pthread_self(), ...) on Linux and also builds on glibc.
issues.fix_suggestion: No change required; the rationale is recorded in notes.md and conandata.yml.

summary: rt-app/1.0 adaptation audited against the code-style and review-memory rule sets. No P0 or P1 findings. The three registered patches are portable C changes with no platform macros; the only genuinely non-trivial fix is the upstream TRUE/FALSE bug that makes tag v1.0 uncompilable on any libc. Dependency paths are private per-package prefixes (R49), the source URL is the official GitHub tag tarball with a pinned sha256 (R39), settings.os is matched as a tuple (R32), build() takes its compiler and flags from the Autotools toolchain rather than bare shell variables (R33), and the delivered executable is registered in a software-level commands.json (R38). The 12-case test_package executes the packaged binary on its real CLI contract, its configuration-rejection paths and a real synthetic workload, and includes two HarmonyOS-specific cases covering the rewritten cpu_set_t / sched affinity surface and the AArch64 ELF identity of the artifact, so no shell test can pass hollowly (R34/PF3). Two P3 advisory notes are recorded for transparency; neither blocks. Verdict: pass.
